title: Emergent Matter Research Framework (EMRF): Geometric Interpretations and Reproducible Astronomical Baselines
description: Version 1.0.0 of research software and auditable development records, not a validated fundamental theory. Candidate A investigates a geometric/energy re-description within GR; no precise universal functional is established. Real-data work includes SPARC penalized profiles and covariance-aware Pantheon+/DESI baselines. Earlier releases mislabeled synthetic data and included circular tests; their headline empirical and self-certification claims are withdrawn. This metadata prepares a new archive. It does not reuse the historical Zenodo DOI or claim a new DOI before Zenodo confirms one.
